features: POWERFUL PERFORMANCE: 600W RMS output delivers rich, room-filling sound that brings greater impact to movies, music, shows, and more.
CINEMATIC AUDIO: Dolby Audio creates detailed, balanced sound with greater clarity for an engaging home entertainment experience.
IMMERSIVE SURROUND: 5.1 CH surround sound with dual rear satellites creates a spacious sound field that puts you closer to the action.
RICH AUDIO: The 3-driver soundbar delivers clear, well-defined audio across your favourite content.
DEEP BASS: The 16.51cm subwoofer adds rich, impactful low frequencies to music, movies, and cinematic soundtracks.
VERSATILE CONNECTIVITY: Connect effortlessly through BT v5.1, TV ARC, Optical IN, USB, and AUX for flexible entertainment setups.
CONVENIENT CONTROLS: The LED display keeps key information visible, while the remote control makes playback and settings easy to manage.
SLEEK SETUP: The wall-mountable design fits neatly into your entertainment space while keeping the setup clean and organised.
